proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂ := nonempty_closedBall.mp ⟨f z, h_maps hz⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne (dslope f c z) 0 with hc | hc
  · simp [hc, div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le]
  rcases exists_dual_vector ℂ _ hc with ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩
  have hg' : ‖g‖₊ = 1 := NNReal.eq hg
  calc
    ‖dslope f c z‖ = ‖dslope (g ∘ f) c z‖ := by
      rw [g.dslope_comp, hgf, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
      exact fun _ => hd.differentiableAt (ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁)
    _ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
      refine schwarz_aux (g.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hd) (MapsTo.comp ?_ h_maps) hz
      simpa [hg'] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂

candidates.requested_change: Replace the `hc` branch with `simp [hc, div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le]` and simplify the last line to `simpa [hg'] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂`.

theorem norm_dslope_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R₁))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R₁) (closedBall (f c) R₂)) (hz : z ∈ ball c R₁) :
    ‖dslope f c z‖ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
  have hR₁ : 0 < R₁ := nonempty_ball.1 ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂ := nonempty_closedBall.mp ⟨f z, h_maps hz⟩
  rcases eq_or_ne (dslope f c z) 0 with hc | hc
  · simpa [hc] using (div_nonneg hR₂ hR₁.le : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R₂ / R₁)
  rcases exists_dual_vector ℂ _ hc with ⟨g, hg, hgf⟩
  have hg' : ‖g‖₊ = 1 := NNReal.eq hg
  calc
    ‖dslope f c z‖ = ‖dslope (g ∘ f) c z‖ := by
      rw [g.dslope_comp, hgf, RCLike.norm_ofReal, abs_norm]
      exact fun _ => hd.differentiableAt (ball_mem_nhds _ hR₁)
    _ ≤ R₂ / R₁ := by
      refine schwarz_aux (g.differentiable.comp_differentiableOn hd) (MapsTo.comp ?_ h_maps) hz
      simpa only [hg', NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] using g.lipschitz.mapsTo_closedBall (f c) R₂

proposed_edit.new_declaration:
theorem norm_deriv_le_one_of_mapsTo_ball (hd : DifferentiableOn ℂ f (ball c R))
    (h_maps : MapsTo f (ball c R) (closedBall (f c) R)) (h₀ : 0 < R) : ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ 1 := by
  simpa [div_self h₀.ne'] using (norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps h₀ : ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ R / R)

candidates.requested_change: Rewrite the proof of `Complex.norm_deriv_le_one_of_mapsTo_ball` as `by simpa [div_self h₀.ne'] using (norm_deriv_le_div_of_mapsTo_ball hd h_maps h₀ : ‖deriv f c‖ ≤ R / R)`.
